text:
Ana: Quick standup for the "mini-tutor" launch next week. Need: landing page + tracking, ~250-word benchmark blurb, a 30m live demo, and a tiny refapp README code sample. Who takes what?

Mike: I can do landing + HubSpot form. Will add hidden utm_campaign=mini_tutor_1 and map to community-sdr.

Ravi: Ill write the bench blurb. Plan: 3 quick bullets + 2 small charts. Keep claims conservative ("up to 2x improvement in our tests"). Need refapp run outputs by EOD.

Jasper: Pushing the refapp sample now: https://git.redwood/refapps/mini-tutor (draft). It has the streaming+cache flow used in your demo.

Pilar: Messaging: headline should highlight outcome not raw numbers. Suggest "Ship predictable LLM features at lower latency." Subhead can give the stat.

Ana: Nice. commops-bot, what's the HubSpot webhook name again?

commops-bot: hs_webhook_mini_tutor. Required property: source_campaign = "mini_tutor_1". Funnel destination: community-sdr@redwood.ai.

Mike: Autoresponder will include calendar invite + link to repo and benchmark PDF. I'll add a thank-you download for the bench.

Ravi: Bench draft will include an appendix with commands used to produce plots and the model config (quant level, batch size). Posting PR in docs by 5pm.

Jasper: I'll add a 3-line SDK snippet to the README showing streaming + KV cache call and record a 2-3 minute screencap for the landing page.

Pilar: Promo: newsletter subject = "Ship predictable LLM features at lower latency". Paid ad headline = "Mini tutorial: deploy a refapp and cut inference costs". Keep creative benefit-first.

Ana: Timeline: landing + form by Wed, bench by Wed EOD, webinar Tue next week, promos Thu. Final messaging review Thursday AM.

Mike: Will share landing preview when up. Also setting conversion event = webinar_reg_complete in marketing dashboard.

commops-bot: Tracking tag created: mini_tutor_1_v1. Conversion goal set to "webinar_reg_complete". :white_check_mark:

Ana: Great work. Loop back if any blockers.
